releases.name: Anka 1.0.1
releases.body:
**Anka 1.0.1** opens games stored as **.nup** packages.

Built from [`anka`](https://github.com/EddizEge/Anka/tree/anka) at `2d17a71ff0f0cf0c27b3d7207818fade9199b77b`; both programs carry this commit.

## Updating from 1.0.0

Close Anka, unzip **`Anka-1.0.1-win64.zip`** into your Anka folder and replace the files. Your `user` folder (settings, keys, firmware and saves) stays as it is.

New to Anka: follow the quick start in the [1.0.0 notes](https://github.com/EddizEge/Anka/releases/tag/anka-v1.0.0). Unzip into a new, empty folder, start `anka.exe`, and install your own keys and firmware.

## What's in 1.0.1

### .nup packages
- `.nup` ("Unencrypted (Archival) Package") is a container format from upstream Eglantine. It holds one title's base game, update and add-on content in a single file.
- Anka now **reads** .nup files. You can open them with **File › Load File…**, and they appear in the game list with their icon, name and version. `anka-cli.exe` and its launchers open them too, including from the `Games` folder.
- Mods (LayeredFS) and Anka's game-specific settings apply to games opened from a .nup, the same as for other formats. Anka finds the title ID before the game starts.

releases.name: Anka 1.0.0
releases.body:
First release of **Anka**, a Nintendo Switch 2 emulator for Windows, focused on performance.

Built from [`anka`](https://github.com/EddizEge/Anka/tree/anka) at `b7542ece8b5c695e2f01d5e46b74c0806d48ae96`; both programs carry this commit.

## Quick start

1. Unzip **`Anka-1.0.0-win64.zip`** into a **new, empty folder**. Do not unzip it into another emulator's folder: its Qt DLLs would replace that program's.
2. Start **`anka.exe`**. Anka keeps its settings, keys, firmware and saves in the `user` folder next to it (portable mode) and does not touch `%APPDATA%\eden` or other installs.
3. Install your own keys and firmware as with other Eden-based emulators. Anka includes no games, keys or firmware; only use what you legally own.
4. Settings: **Emulation › Configure… › Anka**. The first start picks *Recommended*, the setup we measured (with GPU Mode *Fast*, the default; it also turns Reactive Flushing off).

Coming from PokeDinner-Eglantine 2.0.0: back up its `nand` folder (your saves), then copy its `user` folder next to `anka.exe`.

Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit) and a GPU with a current Vulkan driver. Qt and the Visual C++ runtime come with Anka.

## What's in 1.0.0

releases.name: ARMSX3 1.7
releases.body: # ARMSX3 1.7 ## Highlights - **New SPU code compiles in the background.** Games keep running while it compiles, so new areas load without pausing. Games that need the old pause keep it. - **Compiled SPU code now carries over between updates,** including game updates, so first boots after them are quick. Each game compiles once more on its first boot after this update. ## The Last of Us - **Fixed the freeze during play.** The game hands its work to background jobs and waits for them, and on phones a job list could stop with work still in it, freezing the game anywhere from minutes to hours in. ARMSX3 now keeps those jobs moving.

releases.body:
## XMB mode

**The PS3's own menu.** ARMSX3 can now look and work like the PS3's XMB: the wave and sparkles, the boot, every column with its rows and settings, music with the Waves, Valley and Gaia visualizers, a video player, a photo viewer with slideshows, the XMB keyboard, and the in-game XMB with save states, Change Disc and Turn Off System. The icons, words, font and sounds come from your installed firmware, and a PS3 theme brings its own. Turn it on with the wave button in the library bar or in the last step of setup. On an iPhone it holds the screen in landscape, and while a game runs it lets go of its wave to leave the game more memory.

**Built-in Track and Turned off.** The Music column plays a built-in track, and Diagnostics lists a session you ended with Turn Off System as Turned off, where it said Closed by iOS.

releases.body:
Changes since 0.0.1. Thanks to everyone who sent problem reports, since most of these fixes came from them. This is a beta: the JIT changes ran on an iPhone, and everything else was tested on a Mac. Please send a report if something works worse than in 0.0.1.

## Requirements and install

ARMSX3 for iOS needs an iPhone or iPad with an A14 chip or newer, on iOS 17.4 or later. It isn't on the App Store, so install the IPA with SideStore, AltStore or LiveContainer. JIT needs a pairing file for your device (see Pairing files below).

## Update LiveContainer first

If you run ARMSX3 inside LiveContainer, update LiveContainer to 3.8.13 or later before you install this build. That is the nightly build at the moment: https://github.com/LiveContainer/LiveContainer/releases/tag/nightly Older versions can't load the JIT helper, and ARMSX3 will fall back to StikDebug.

In LiveContainer, turn on Helper Process Support for ARMSX3, and open ARMSX3 full screen, not in a window.

releases.name: ARMSX3 1.6.7
releases.body: # ARMSX3 1.6.7 Most of this release is @J1coding's work: fixes he found while bringing ARMSX3 to iOS, now on Android too. ## New - **Faster boots**: ARMSX3 now keeps a game's compiled SPU code between boots. The first boot after an update builds it once, and every boot after that loads it. On an Odin 3, Spider-Man: Web of Shadows' SPU step takes 2.5 s instead of 16 s. It lives in ARMSX3's own cache folder on the phone, which Android can clear like any app cache, and it switches itself off when the phone has less than 1 GB free. Done by @J1coding. ## Rare-case fixes - **Leaving a game no longer gets stuck** on memory the graphics side had locked. Done by @J1coding.

releases.body:
# v0.4.8 主要更新

新增：视频实时翻译，识别视频或游戏正在播放的对白，以双语对照悬浮字幕显示原文和译文，没有原字幕也能使用。支持本地模型或在线识别，需要 Android 10 及以上版本。

新增：手势模式，支持八种手势分别绑定功能，并可通过点击主球、侧滑唤起、左右旋转或前后倾斜触发。

新增：快捷面板，集中显示六种模式、语言方向和四个快捷操作，支持横竖屏布局。

新增：本地模型管理，支持下载模型、导入 GGUF、独立保存模型参数，以及使用相同原文试译比较。

新增：Index-Translate、Qwen3、LFM2.5、Gemma 和 TranslateGemma 等本地模型选择。

新增：Root 和无障碍截屏，支持自动选择可用方式，也可手动切换截屏方式。

新增：「B站翻译(免费)」，内置服务配置，选择后即可联网使用，感谢bilibili的免费翻译服务。

新增：「PP-OCRv5 东斯拉夫语」模型，支持俄语、白俄罗斯语、乌克兰语和英语识别。

新增：开发者选项支持隐藏 OCR 置信度不足或未识别到有效文字时的红色提示。

新增：[Issue #31](https://github.com/ciddwd/overlay-translator/issues/31) 提出的阿拉伯语界面翻译，感谢 [Maxaseel](https://github.com/Maxaseel) 提供翻译。

优化：日漫 OCR 加速，**已下载旧版日漫模型的用户，可点击「补充下载」，在保持识别精度的同时加快识别，无需删除重下。** 同时优化 PaddleOCR 识别，减少重复识别和图案误识别，改善漫画原文擦除、背景修复及译文排版，减少残字、越界和排版拥挤。

优化：主页布局，更方便地查看预设、当前状态、截屏服务和批量翻译任务。

优化：悬浮球设置分组，将贴边、菜单按钮、触发方式和手势绑定分别整理到独立页面，统一模式切换提示。

优化：设置选择控件，统一选中块样式，增加滑动切换效果，并调整高度、边距与交互反馈。

优化：自动识别设置，使用语言卡片管理识别方式、模型选择和下载状态。

releases.body:
Hello!

It's been a little while, so I thought I would just give a small update on project status. 

- Winlator Cmod development continues!
- My focus on next release will either be mostly QoL. This means addressing long standing bug fixes, but more importantly, **merging and crediting improvements from other forks of Cmod from trusted developers.** Primarily I'll be focused on:

- Minor UI improvements and enhancements

_Minor update v13.1.1 fixed custom icons, default renderer, and warning prompt handling on new installs_ 

------------------------------

-   **`evshim` Rewrite:** The entire controller shim (`libevshim.so`) has been rewritten, **completely eliminating the use of shared memory (`mmap`)**, resulting in a massive reduction in CPU overhead and a significant performance boost, especially on lower-end devices. Box64 3.2 and 3.6 are now compatible, and have been restored.

-   **ALSA-Reflector Improved** The pacer's ring buffer and reconnection logic have been refined, expect better performance and reliability.

-   **Universal CPU Overhead Reduction:** I've gone through the code to find and eliminate performance bottlenecks, once again, big thanks to @Pipetto-crypto as always for the guidance and his improvements to the Graphics Wrapper. 

### ✨ New Feature: VkBasalt Integration

-   **Per-Shortcut Sharpening & Effects:** Thanks to @Pipetto-crypto You can now enable VkBasalt on a per-shortcut basis to apply CAS and DLS to your games.

### 🐞 Stability & Bug Fixes:

This update includes a huge number of fixes for a smoother experience.

releases.name: Winlator Cmod - Project Status Update - April 2025
releases.body:
### Statement on BrunoSX’s hiatus
Bruno (@brunodev85) announced he’s pausing Winlator development after false virus accusations. There are no viruses in Winlator, at least not intentionally—debug symbols in the bundled Wine builds can trigger antivirus heuristics, but I realize that the latest release had something a bit different that scrambled executable file names. The reality is that these things can happen, it's certainly not intentional. *Update: TestD3D.exe _was_ infected with floxif. Again, this was not intentional, but it should be noted.  

### Where Cmod & the Bionic fork stand
My own Cmod branch has been quiet since Prototype 5 / v12 alpha (Discord-only). Meanwhile, amazing work continues:

@Pipetto-crypto – Bionic & graphics wrappers

@cjxyz – Bionic Winlator fork and new features

### My roadmap
I’m resuming work—slowly, around a busier job—but the plan is:

🔧 Fix Gamepad Configurator

🖥️ Streamline Big Picture Mode (Cmod Big Picture Mode, the frontend looking menu I made a while back. But Steam support is still on my radar)

🍷 Update Wine & core assets

🏷️ Expand on shortcut settings / per-app tweaks

Expect incremental releases rather than one big drop.

This release finalizes the 5.0 series.

Emulation accuracy
- New option CPU_START_DELAY staggers the CPU start relative to the beam. Without it, some memory configurations always hit a timing race in Kickstart 1.3’s PAL/NTSC detection (#1029).
- Reinstated the ADF track-length fix that had been dropped by mistake (#1021).

Usability
- Improved auto-warp condition (#1008).

Under the hood
- Public API cleanup

Bug fixes:
- Improved AGA support (#999, #1003, #1004, #1009, #1011, #1012, #1013).

New features: 
- AGA support

# Release Notes

## Enhancements

- The floppy disk API now supports disk images stored in memory buffers (#992)
- Added proper gamma correction to the palette builders (#998)
- Replaced the 4096-entry palette lookup table with a smaller table based on an affine transformation, paving the way for AGA support.

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed a bug that caused the server launch daemon to fire every cycle (#990)
- Fixed a bug that prevented preferences from loading correctly (#995)
- Added guard checks for potential Swift `nil` values

releases.name: Snap64 Recomp 1.1.8
Snap64 Recomp 1.1.8-test1 (test build for issue 39)
releases.body:
**This is a test build, not a release.** It is for [issue 39](https://github.com/JackandBeans/Snap64Recomp/issues/39): on a phone with an Exynos 2400, the Android app shows the same graphics message at every start once Anti-Aliasing is set to 8x. Everyone else should use [1.1.7](https://github.com/JackandBeans/Snap64Recomp/releases/tag/v1.1.7).

It is the code that will become 1.1.8, as it stands today. When the phone cannot make a picture buffer at the settings chosen, the port lowers a setting and asks for a restart. 1.1.7 only ever lowered Super Sampling, so with Super Sampling already at 1x nothing changed and every start ended the same way. This build lowers one setting each time: Super Sampling, then Anti-Aliasing, then Color Depth, then Render Scale. It never asks for an Anti-Aliasing level the phone does not offer, it remembers a level that failed, and the log names the levels the phone offers.

Install it over 1.1.7. Saves stay. If 1.1.7 left the phone stuck, the first start of this build should lower Anti-Aliasing to 4x by itself and get into the game. If it still stops, attach `snap64.log` from Internal storage > Snap64 to issue 39.

releases.name: Snap64 Recomp 1.1.7-test4 (test build for issue 36)
releases.body:
**This is a test build, not a release.** It is for the crash in [issue 36](https://github.com/JackandBeans/Snap64Recomp/issues/36): on an AYN Thor, the Android app closes as the game starts. Everyone else should use [1.1.7](https://github.com/JackandBeans/Snap64Recomp/releases/tag/v1.1.7).

It is [1.1.7-test3](https://github.com/JackandBeans/Snap64Recomp/releases/tag/v1.1.7-test3) with a fix for the crash that build recorded. The Thor's graphics driver crashed at the end of the first drawing pass of the first frame. That pass held a reset of the renderer's timers, which Vulkan does not allow inside a drawing pass. The port's own clear of new picture buffers had left the pass open. Now the reset, and the two other steps Vulkan keeps outside a drawing pass, close an open pass first. The log says so once.

The crash record from test3 stays in. If the app still closes, open it once more, then attach `snap64.log` to issue 36. Saves stay.

releases.name: Snap64 Recomp 1.1.7-test3 (test build for issue 36)
releases.body:
**This is a test build, not a release.** It is for the crash in [issue 36](https://github.com/JackandBeans/Snap64Recomp/issues/36): on an AYN Thor, the Android app closes as the game starts. Everyone else should use [1.1.7](https://github.com/JackandBeans/Snap64Recomp/releases/tag/v1.1.7).

It does not fix the crash. It records it. [1.1.7-test2](https://github.com/JackandBeans/Snap64Recomp/releases/tag/v1.1.7-test2) answered the first fault on the Thor, a table of textures the driver refused. The app still closes a moment later, and the log has no line for it. This build writes the reason into `snap64.log`:

- When the app closes on a fault, it writes the signal, the thread, the graphics call that thread was in, and the code addresses.
- At the next start, it copies in Android's own report of how the last run ended.

To help: install it over what you have, open it, let it close, open it once more, then attach `snap64.log` to issue 36. Saves stay.

releases.name: Snap64 Recomp 1.1.7-test2 (test build for issue 36)
releases.body:
**This is a test build, not a release.** It is for the crash in [issue 36](https://github.com/JackandBeans/Snap64Recomp/issues/36): on an AYN Thor, the Android app closes as the game starts. Everyone else should use [1.1.7](https://github.com/JackandBeans/Snap64Recomp/releases/tag/v1.1.7).

It is 1.1.7 with one file of the renderer changed. On a Qualcomm graphics driver, the renderer's table of textures now gets its full declared size, and on any driver a table that is refused is asked for once more. Three guards came with it: a refused table is no longer written to, and clears and scissors are kept inside what Vulkan allows. The log says more about what the driver answers. The change is attached as `plume-issue36.patch`.

The APK is signed with the project's key, so it installs over 1.1.7 and saves stay. Android's app info shows it as 1.1.7-test2.

It has been checked on Android's emulator only. The same game code passed the Android checks, 114 of 114. The signed file installed over 1.1.7 with its files kept, and passed the fix's own check, which plays the Qualcomm driver's rule, 23 of 23. It has not run on a Thor yet. That is what this build is for.

releases.name: Joycon2Android 3.1.0

releases.name: BOTWRecompAndroid 0.4.7 (beta 39): mapa certo com a Economia de RAM, opção de sombras e menos esperas por shaders
releases.body:
**Beta 39.** O mapa e o minimapa não ficam mais escuros com a Economia de RAM ligada, chega a opção Vídeo > Sombras, e o jogo espera menos por shaders. Várias mudanças vieram de colaboradores (obrigado, Propinbo e HallanBR!).

## Correções

- **Mapa e minimapa escuros com a "Economia de RAM" ligada (#471, #478):** com o zoom no mapa, ou no minimapa, a imagem ficava escura.
  - **Causa:** com a Economia de RAM, depois de enviar uma textura à GPU o app devolvia a memória dela ao Android, e essa memória passava a ler zeros. Mas o jogo às vezes cria a textura de novo sobre a mesma memória sem carregar o arquivo outra vez, e ela era enviada a partir dos zeros.
  - **Agora:** a memória vai para o swap do Android com o conteúdo guardado: a economia continua, e nada vira zero. Se você tinha o problema, conte se resolveu.
- **Frame rate 40 / 45 em telas de 120 Hz (#455):** o HyperOS deixa o jogo em 60 Hz até ele pedir mais, e o modo caía para 30. Agora o app pergunta ao Android a maior taxa que a tela oferece e pede 120 Hz. Contribuição do HallanBR.

## Novidades

releases.name: BOTWRecompAndroid 0.4.6 (beta 38): a água tem colisão de novo, e menos lentidão depois de carregar
releases.body:
**Beta 38.** O Link não atravessa mais a água dos rios depois de um tempo jogando, o jogo volta à velocidade normal 1 s depois de cada carregamento, e vários fechamentos foram corrigidos. Várias correções vieram de colaboradores (obrigado, Propinbo!).

## Correções

- **Água sem colisão depois de um tempo (#296, #438):** depois de 30-60 min, o Link afundava nos rios e andava no fundo, com a água ainda desenhada por cima. Só reiniciar o app resolvia.
  - **Causa:** um pedaço da textura de altura da água era recriado em branco e escrito de volta por cima do que o jogo usa para a colisão.
  - **Agora:** o conteúdo é carregado antes. Correção do Propinbo (#461).
- **Lento por ~10 s depois de cada carregamento (#465):** depois de carregar o save ou de uma viagem rápida, o "Sync lag" (Vídeo) ficava desligado por 300 quadros. Em GPUs mais fracas isso eram ~12 s a 17-20 fps.
  - **Agora:** ele volta depois de 1 s. A água continua certa (era o motivo da espera longa); conferido na torre do Grande Platô.

releases.name: BOTWRecompAndroid 0.4.5 (beta 37): menos memória presa e melhorias vindas do TOTK
releases.body:
**Beta 37.** Os shaders do jogo deixam de ficar para sempre na memória, o FXAA ficou mais leve, e chegam quatro melhorias do [TOTKDroid](https://github.com/mamcjr/TOTKDroid): o relógio do modo Nativo nos aparelhos MediaTek, mais dois efeitos de áudio do jogo, e texturas e vértices no modo cópia (Mali, Xclipse).

## Memória

- **Shaders liberados ao reiniciar o jogo:** cada vez que o jogo era reiniciado ou voltava à tela inicial pelo menu do app, ficavam na memória todos os shaders e pipelines já montados. Agora eles são liberados. Num teste com 16 trocas de cena, a memória terminou em 1075 MB em vez de 1646 MB.
- **Shaders sem uso liberados na Mali e nas outras GPUs não Adreno (#450):** os shaders nunca eram liberados durante o jogo (1513 vivos depois de 30 min, quando uma Mali-G720 fechou no limite de memória do Android). Agora, passados de 1000, os que ficaram 10 min (depois 3 min) sem uso são liberados e montados de novo quando o jogo voltar a usá-los. Deve reduzir os fechamentos em sessões longas na Mali, mas ainda falta confirmar num aparelho Mali: se você tinha esse problema, conte se melhorou.

## Vindo do TOTK

releases.name: BOTWRecompAndroid 0.4.4 (beta 36): sem queda de fps depois dos menus
releases.body:
# BOTWRecompAndroid 0.4.4 (beta 36): sem queda de fps depois dos menus

**Beta 36.** O jogo volta à velocidade normal logo depois de um menu, e a geração de quadros chega a mais GPUs Mali.

## Correções

- **Queda de fps depois de qualquer menu (#374, #439, #433):** por uns 12 s depois de fechar o menu de pausa, o inventário ou a troca de runas, o jogo ficava em 20-27 fps e depois voltava ao normal.
  - **Causa:** ao fechar o menu, o app desligava o "Sync lag" (Vídeo) por 300 quadros, como depois de uma tela de carregamento.
  - **Agora:** o menu não conta mais como saída do mundo. No POCO F7 Ultra, os trechos de 2 s abaixo de 29 fps depois dos menus caíram de 12 para 0.
- **Preso em 20 fps depois de um engasgo:** um engasgo isolado (save, menu, shaders compilando) não leva mais o jogo para 20 fps. E, se ele estiver em 20 fps, tenta voltar a 30 a cada poucos segundos, em vez de esperar o trabalho por quadro cair muito.
- **Geração de quadros: "no Lossless.dll" com o arquivo no lugar certo (#437, #385):** o Android mostra o arquivo em Download/ para o app, mas não deixa abrir sem a permissão de acesso a todos os arquivos.

releases.name: BOTWRecompAndroid 0.4.3 (beta 35): geração de quadros em telas de 120 Hz ou mais
releases.body:
**Beta 35.** A geração de quadros (LSFG) agora funciona em celulares em que o Android deixava o jogo a 60 Hz mesmo com uma tela mais rápida, como no ROG Phone 8.

## Correções

- **Geração de quadros sem efeito em telas rápidas:** com o jogo a 40–50 fps e a tela a 60 Hz, não sobrava espaço para nenhum quadro gerado, e o jogo continuava igual. Isso acontecia mesmo em telas de 120 ou 165 Hz, porque o Android deixa o jogo a 60 Hz se o app não pede outra taxa.
  - Agora, com a geração ligada, o app pede ao Android uma taxa com espaço para os quadros gerados: a taxa de quadros escolhida vezes o multiplicador (60 fps × 2 = 120 Hz). O sistema escolhe o modo mais próximo que a tela tem.
  - Se ainda assim não couber nenhum quadro, Vídeo > Geração de quadros agora diz isso, em vez de "gerando". Para abrir espaço, aumente a taxa de atualização nas configurações de tela ou do modo jogo do celular (no ROG, o Game Genie), ou baixe a Taxa de quadros.

> **Não precisa compilar o código do jogo de novo:** é só instalar por cima.

## Problemas conhecidos

- **4 GB de RAM:** perto de 20 fps no mundo, mas ainda abaixo disso na média, e o fps cai quando o aparelho esquenta.

mamcjr-botwrecompandroid.latest_body:
**Beta 39.** O mapa e o minimapa não ficam mais escuros com a Economia de RAM ligada, chega a opção Vídeo > Sombras, e o jogo espera menos por shaders. Várias mudanças vieram de colaboradores (obrigado, Propinbo e HallanBR!).

## Correções

- **Mapa e minimapa escuros com a "Economia de RAM" ligada (#471, #478):** com o zoom no mapa, ou no minimapa, a imagem ficava escura.
  - **Causa:** com a Economia de RAM, depois de enviar uma textura à GPU o app devolvia a memória dela ao Android, e essa memória passava a ler zeros. Mas o jogo às vezes cria a textura de novo sobre a mesma memória sem carregar o arquivo outra vez, e ela era enviada a partir dos zeros.
  - **Agora:** a memória vai para o swap do Android com o conteúdo guardado: a economia continua, e nada vira zero. Se você tinha o problema, conte se resolveu.
- **Frame rate 40 / 45 em telas de 120 Hz (#455):** o HyperOS deixa o jogo em 60 Hz até ele pedir mais, e o modo caía para 30. Agora o app pergunta ao Android a maior taxa que a tela oferece e pede 120 Hz. Contribuição do HallanBR.

# Banana Native 0.3.40: play first, shaders build while you do

Install over 0.3.26 or update in the app. Games, packs, saves and settings are kept. Guides for everything below: https://git.eden-emu.dev/moceure/BananaNative/wiki


## Start a game in minutes, not hours
**Shaders are now built while you play.** Prepare can skip them: the game starts at once and the app builds the shaders it needs in the background. A small count at the top of the screen shows the work ("Building shaders (N)"; Settings > Building shaders label). Built shaders are kept, so they are built only once. For seven games (Ocarina of Time, Donkey Kong Bananza, Mario Kart World, Mario Tennis Fever, Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave, Star Fox, Pokopia) a starter list is built while the title loads. 
- Expect a half-empty picture for a while on a game with no library; Ocarina of Time needs a few sessions before the pop-in stops.
- After an app update, a quick sample check can **keep your existing shaders** instead of rebuilding them all.

**New — Frame Generation (experimental)**
- **Frame Generation ships as an opt-in**: toggle it live in the Quick-Access blade (L3+R3) or per
  game in settings. It runs AMD FidelityFX optical-flow frame interpolation inside Ryudeck's own
  Vulkan present path — no external layers — presenting an interpolated frame between each pair of

  frame rate (measured on device: ~21-30 fps rendered → ~42-60 presented).

  stall), so sudden hitches are never smeared into interpolated frames.

- Added Lua 5.4 scripting: `File > Script > Lua` opens a script editor on win32, Qt and GTK, with syntax colouring, line numbers, completion, an API reference, a console and session restore.

- `-lua <script>` runs a script from the command line.
- `gui.set_antialias` smooths lines, circles, ellipses and polygons.
- No speed cost while no script is loaded.
- Guide and API reference: [Lua scripting](https://github.com/shanytc/snes9x/blob/master/docs/lua-scripting.md)

- DSP-1, DSP-1B, DSP-2, DSP-3, DSP-4 and the Cx4 now run as native chips that match their firmware instruction for instruction, with no dump needed.
- Each chip can also run its firmware dump (new BIOS Manager slots), or the old HLE.

# Nintendo Super System
- Added Nintendo Super System arcade support: Z80 supervisor, 
- key chip, on-screen display, three cartridge sockets and the front panel.
- Twelve of the thirteen dumped cartridges run, including HiROM and DSP-1 boards.
- Named the cartridge DIP switches for ActRaiser, The Addams Family, Lethal Weapon and Robocop 3.
- The supervisor's reset silences the APU too, Restart has to be held as on the cabinet, and nocash's test program is accepted as a BIOS.

- Note: not all games might work out of the box - some issues might occur during game play / boot.

- BIOS mode carries its cycle remainder instead of flooring twice, and deducts GB cycle overshoot (fixes audio pacing).
- Packet bits latch on the rising edge, not the falling one.
- MASK_EN honored on the BIOS pane, LCD-off treated as a freeze.
- Boot logo held on displayed content, hidden under the SGB BIOS, and shown only when a boot ROM was actually assigned.

releases.name: Termux-Aether 1000.0.0
releases.body:
## Pacman suite (packaging revision 2)

Download **`termux-aether-suite-aarch64.pkg.tar.xz`** and its `.sha256` file. This is a real Pacman package:

```sh
sha256sum -c termux-aether-suite-aarch64.pkg.tar.xz.sha256
pacman -U ./termux-aether-suite-aarch64.pkg.tar.xz
```

It directly owns the native runtime and API commands and stages both APKs under `$PREFIX/share/termux-aether-suite`. Update Android apps using `aether-apks api`, then `aether-apks app`; Android confirms these updates. Existing app IDs, signatures and data paths are preserved. Shizuku and Arch images remain optional.

If you previously installed Aether commands manually, download `aether-install.py` and its checksum too:

```sh
sha256sum -c aether-install.py.sha256
python aether-install.py --adopt-legacy ./termux-aether-suite-aarch64.pkg.tar.xz
```

This backs up only the nine known unowned legacy commands and transfers ownership to Pacman. Unrelated files/packages are refused. No wildcard overwrite or editing of checksum-protected scripts is needed. Use `aether-update` for later protected upgrades, or install new suite packages with `pacman -U` directly.

releases.body:
**Test build, not a normal release.** Made for the Mangmi Air X (Adreno 610) and other devices where "Vulkan could not be loaded" appears.

Some phones' graphics drivers advertise a debug extension (VK_EXT_debug_utils) without providing its functions. The app used to treat that as fatal and fall back to the slow OpenGL renderer. In this build that extension is optional, so Vulkan can start.

This build also contains the Retro Rewind login fix from test 2 (the game now waits up to 5 seconds for the login reply).

Install it over your current DriftDroid. Your settings and saves stay. Open the game, then press "Export Diagnostics" on the main screen and attach the zip, even if it works. If Vulkan still fails, the log shows what failed next.

It is built from commit f15608e. The Dawn change is not in the repository yet; it will be added as a patch file.

releases.body:
**Test build, not a normal release.** For people who got Retro Rewind error 20100 when going online. This replaces test 1, which did not work.

releases.name: v11.5
releases.body:
## v11.5 摘要

**批量 / 扫描导入** — 导入向导第一步新增「批量扫描导入（多选）」：选一个目录（例如 Download），用 SAF 扫出候选——顶层带 `.exe` / `.rpy` / `.rpyc` / `.xp3` / `.rpa` / `.ypf` / `.wolf` / `.rgssad` / `.nsa` 之一，或是 Ren'Py 的 `game/` 目录；套娃目录只下探一层，跳过隐藏目录与运行时目录。勾选后**串行**导入，每条独立汇报「等待 / 复制中 / 导入中 / 已导入 / 失败」，失败项复用单条导入的回滚（删已建容器根目录 + 清暂存）。批量**不**自动拉起内置引擎，导完统一回游戏库自己点。

**分类过滤由「单选」升级为「三维组合」** — 引擎 + 品类 + 标签可同时生效（AND），同一维度再点一次取消；筛空时空态文案改为「没有匹配的游戏」。「继续游玩」改为按最后启动时间倒序且只收真启动过的（`lastPlayedAt > 0`）——此前是「列表前 3 个」，名不副实；没玩过任何游戏时整段隐藏。

**封面（提取修复 + 用户自定义）** — ①`BitmapFactory` 解不了 PE 资源里的原始 DIB，所以卡片封面一直是占位图；新增 `IconCodec` 兜底（补 14 字节 `BITMAPFILEHEADER`、`biHeight` 减半剥掉 AND 掩码层、按 8bpp 调色板算偏移），组内候选按字节数降序逐个重试——真机上那款 Unity 游戏的 exe 图标首次正常显示。②详情页「维护 → 封面」可**从相册选图**或**恢复自动**，优先级 自定义 > 目录图 > exe 图标；选图先落 `.tmp` 并实际解码一次，解不开的不落盘。③修「换完封面回列表仍显示占位图」：解码完成前同一位置可能已被重绑到另一个 View，旧逻辑只贴给回调持有者；现在解码完成后让列表按缓存位图重画一次。

**UI 修正（真机实测出来的）** — 多选条加「品类 / 标签」后，六个动作把「已选 N 项」挤成 0 宽、「完成」被截断：标签简化为「删除 / 移除」、收紧边距、计数给最小宽度，全部回到一行内。「彻底删除 / 仅移除」确认弹窗从**只报数量**改为**列出游戏名**，并写明原生游戏的收纳副本同样会被删（真机复验时因只报数量误删过一批，当场从仍在的源目录重新导入恢复）。

releases.name: v11.4
releases.body:
## v11.4 摘要

**导入重做** — 第一步从「手输路径」换成系统文件夹选择器（`ACTION_OPEN_DOCUMENT_TREE` + persistable 授权），授权跟目录走、不随卸载重装重置；所选目录先复制进应用私有暂存（带进度、失败清半成品、可用空间 <128MB 硬失败、6h 残骸清扫）再走原管线。

**导入假成功链（真机事故 D1–D5）** — 重装后「所有文件访问」被系统重置时 `listFiles()` 为 null，旧行为一路「成功」到启动才报「启动文件缺失」：现 step0 fail-fast 并带用户去授权页。同批修复：解压套娃目录归一（`resolveGameRoot`，JVM 回归 E15–E21）、库条目回填标题/引擎、CJK 目录名塌缩改附哈希后缀、容器名恒等 `galgame-<gameId>`（避让上移到 id 派生）、导入失败回滚已建容器、复制完成无 exe 当场告警、重复导入先确认。

**游戏库分类** — 顶部 chips 单选过滤：引擎自动归类（多于一种才出现）、预置内容品类（视觉小说 / 文字冒险 / 其他）、自定义标签；长按多选后「品类 / 标签」可一次给多张卡归类，标签可内联新建。

**数据安全三件** — ①「彻底删除」补删 `files/galgame-native` 收纳副本（此前数 GB 静默泄漏）并校验结果；②索引改 `.tmp`+`fsync`+rename 原子写，解析失败先隔离 `.corrupt-<ts>` 再重建；③存档管理器拒绝空 gameId（跨游戏串档），便携存档「先搬后链」改为合并不完整就不删源、链接失败把档拷回、同名冲突留 `.bak`。

**运维事实（重要）** — 卸载重装 / 清数据会重置全部文件权限（含「所有文件访问」），ColorOS/Android 16 上 shell 无法代授，只能用户手动开；新的导入流程不依赖该权限。

**真机验收** — RMX5010 / Adreno 830 / Android 16，release 包 11.4：选择器全链路（Download → 游戏目录 → 使用此文件夹）→ 检测 UNITY / 5 个文件 → 导入 → 单卡启动 → 标题菜单 → 正片连续推进对白 100s+；分类三条链路（品类/标签/引擎 chips，筛选取值 1/1/2）；把索引写成非法 JSON 后改一次分类 → 旧文件留档、新索引字段正确；注入 2MB 收纳副本后彻底删除 → 目录归空。

releases.name: v11.3
releases.body:
## v11.3 摘要

**界面** — Swiss 单首页 IA 与全站视觉重构：内页与游戏内 UI 收进同一套视觉语言；明暗双档走同一套主题 token（`values-night` 反相，状态栏图标随档位切换）；「设置 → 输入控制」从死路接成真入口；运行环境可管理（详情 / 重新注入语言字体 / 删除）。

**引擎** — 指纹扩展到 **19 个**（Siglus / YU-RIS / Artemis / CatSystem2 / AdvHD / SystemNNN / BGI / CMVS / Unity 等）；新增 `detectDeep()` 有限深度下钻（深度 ≤3、预算 4000 项），修子目录 `.xp3` 被判 UNKNOWN 后无法升级路由的问题。

**稳定性** — 修复 X server 输出流的静默截断与 SIGPIPE：`XOutputStream_send` 由裸阻塞 `write()` 改为 `send(MSG_NOSIGNAL)` 循环写满，EINTR 重试、EAGAIN 时 `poll` 上限 2 秒。

**工程** — box64 自建变成可复现资产（私有补丁导出 + 双向校验 + 构建脚本 + 打包器入库，版本不再写死）；类型门禁修绿（热点清单 3 → 6 条、`R` 桩 100 → 183 符号）；运行时资源 SHA-256 清单补齐 `assets` 子目录（34 → 57 个文件）。

**已知限制** — 走 DirectShow 的引擎（SystemNNN / YU-RIS 等）过场动画仍黑屏。根因已定位到 Wine 内建 quartz 的 `IVideoWindow::put_WindowStyle` → `SetWindowPos` 跨线程 `SendMessage` 永不返回（`IMediaControl::Run` 从未被调用），属 Wine 侧问题、应用层不可改，登记为 TD-09。

**真机验收** — RMX5010 / Adreno 830 / Android 16，release 包：库页 19 条正常、详情页与设置页正常、版本号显示 11.3、锚点《花瓣！》`HANA9cn.EXE` 经 UI 完整路径启动并渲染标题画面。

- **Soporte multi-región y fix de modelos negros (PR #26 / PR #27):** Resolución automática `ADRP+LDR` para USA y Asia 1.0.3 (presenter y resolución dinámica mínima `0.6`) y firma ampliada de 8 instrucciones en `mesh_draw_hook` para evitar falsos matches y modelos/naves en negro.

## The app no longer carries the game profiles

The profiles are half a gigabyte of shader tables, and every release
copied them again. This build carries none of them. After the update,
import the profiles package once: Settings → the environment check, or the
profiles row's "manage" box, which can fetch this build's own package for
you (the download is digest-checked). The package is the release's second
file. It lives outside the app's own storage, so future updates never
touch it.

**Packs built with this version need this app to run** - the pack no
longer carries the runtime inside; the app keeps one runtime per game and
builds it when the game page opens. The games already on your phone keep
working.

### New
- The game page checks and rebuilds the game itself; a failure shows the
  reason with a retry. The "update runtime" chore is gone.
- Tapping a game resumes it or refuses it - no more wrongly greyed-out
  cards.
- Pin a game to the home screen from its detail panel; the shortcut opens
  through the launch gate and greys out when the game is deleted.
- A port can be exported as one folder and taken to another phone; the
  same game can be in the library twice.

The Android line's fourteenth alpha. The phone app is the whole tool: it ports a game on the device itself and plays the data pack it makes.

This one is a pre-release: it does not become the repository's "Latest" release, so the players on the current version are not pushed onto an alpha.

## Changelog

### New games

- **13 Sentinels: Aegis Rim (Asia)** - the Chinese release (the Japanese and Korean ones too); it installs beside the western one, so both play on the same phone. Tested on the Xiaomi 23117RK66C: the port runs, the Chinese text and the cutscenes play, the save menu works, 58-59 fps at 1440p.

### New

- **The port shows what it is doing.** The rewriter's own progress lines reach the screen while the port runs, so a working port is not mistaken for a stuck one (a player sat 75 minutes in a run that needed about three, and gave up). The log bundle's device snapshot gives every relevant process's CPU time and age - the two numbers that tell a working process from a stuck one.

The Android line's thirteenth alpha. The phone app is the whole tool: it ports a game on the device itself and plays the data pack it makes.

This one is a pre-release: it does not become the repository's "Latest" release, so the players on the current version are not pushed onto an alpha.

## Changelog

### Before you update

- **The player API moved to revision 6 (the game's mode).** A data pack made with an older one is marked as needing a runtime update. "Update runtime" in the library rebuilds it in place: the game does not have to be ported again, and your saves are kept.
- **The host changed with this release.** The upstream line's work is in the host, so the update brings the new engine fixes and the new tools with it. A pack that is not updated keeps running on the host it was built with.

### New

- **The file managers see the app's own folders.** The runtime rootfs, the tools, the hosts, the saves, the drivers and the logs show up as one root: the player can read, create, rename, move and delete there without a computer. The switch is in Settings, About ("File manager access"), on by default, and it takes effect at once, without a restart.

The Android line's twelfth alpha. The phone app is the whole tool: it ports a game on the device itself and plays the data pack it makes.

This one is a pre-release: it does not become the repository's "Latest" release, so the players on the current version are not pushed onto an alpha.

## Changelog

### Before you update

- **"Update runtime" is more forgiving.** The upstream sync changed the profile fingerprints, so an older data pack met a refusal where the player was pushed back to a full re-port. The app asks now instead of ending the road: "continue with the current profile" rebuilds the runtime in place, so the game does not have to be ported again and your saves are kept.
- **The external display needs the new runtime.** The row in the drawer shows up after "update runtime" rebuilt the pack's host. Nothing else changes.
- This release carries the upstream line's work: the engine's own fixes and three more games that play on Android.

### New games

- Xenoblade Chronicles: Definitive Edition (30 fps; it rarely crashes on boot - about 1 in 35 - and saving and the later maps are not tested yet)
- Ultra Kaiju Monster Rancher
